storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/swpckindex/ (gz after 2 days)

field_map.time_tag: start of the 3-hour UTC window, dedup key (readings are immutable once posted)
field_map.a_running: running daily A-index at time of reading, or null
field_map.station_count: number of contributing magnetometer stations, or null

confidence_model: RAW official readings. NOAA's own published Kp -> G-scale storm-class formula is applied for display (classifyKp), not a derived/fitted signal. Mike's GIC hypothesis (geomagnetic storms stress grid transformers) is filed in research/open_questions.md GRID-ADJACENT FUTURE ROOTS #1 and stays gate-1-unvalidated — this stream is display + archive only.
cadence: 5-min poll of a 3-hourly, ~7.5-day rolling upstream window
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). Live-data gap sweep 2026-07-27 (research/open_questions.md) picked this up as the recommended next keyless build. Paired stream: swpcxray.json (X-ray flux, same PR).
